about_blocks.text: Services Offered by Hollyburn Family Services
about_blocks.html: Services Offered by Hollyburn Family Services

about_blocks.text: Hollyburn Family Services is a multi-service agency providing various services to children, youth, adults, and families in the Greater Vancouver region since 1990. The agency is dedicated to strengthening child, youth, adult, and family functioning through quality therapeutic and support services. Hollyburn offers a range of professional counselling services to help individuals, couples, and families with issues such as depression, anxiety, stress, trauma, and relationship problems. The agency’s counsellors provide a safe, supportive, and confidential environment where clients can express themselves without fear of judgement.

about_blocks.text: Hollyburn also supports families of children with Autism Spectrum Disorder and other pervasive developmental disorders. The agency provides a range of services to help families cope with the challenges associated with raising a child with developmental disorders. These services include counselling, education, training, and respite care. Hollyburn’s team of dedicated professionals works collaboratively with families to develop individualized care plans that address the needs of each family member.

about_blocks.text: Hollyburn provides residential care for children and adults with developmental disabilities and mental health challenges. The agency’s residential programs are designed to provide a safe and nurturing environment where residents can develop the skills they need to live as independently as possible. Hollyburn’s highly trained and compassionate staff provides 24-hour care and support to ensure that residents receive the attention and guidance they need to achieve their goals.

about_blocks.text: Hollyburn Family Services is a rehabilitation center specializing in treating substance abuse and related issues. They offer a comprehensive and individualized care plan after a thorough assessment of each patient’s unique situation. Their experienced counselors utilize various techniques to facilitate communication, self-discovery, and healing in their patients. Through individual or group counseling sessions, patients can identify personal targets and goals, which are incorporated into their care plan.

about_blocks.text: Hollyburn Family Services is equipped with amenities that enhance the overall rehabilitation experience. Patients can benefit from substance abuse treatment, assessment, and therapies that include holistic approaches, evidence-based practices, yoga and meditation, nutritional counseling, art, and nature therapy. Their services also extend to family therapy and counseling, which helps patients and their families develop a better understanding of the effects of substance abuse and the path to recovery. Hollyburn Family Services’ dedicated team is committed to providing clients with the best possible care, leading to successful rehabilitation and reintegration.
